rule_extra: Controller personal gifts stay on the person. Opening The Atlantic does not open Powell Jobs. Opening WJLA does not open David D. Smith.

records.summary: Powell Jobs's federal file is Democratic and large. FEC itemized gifts in the 2023–24 window include $929,000 (20 Sep 2023) and $923,000 (29 Aug 2024) to Biden Victory Fund, $123,900 × 2 to the DNC, $3,300 to Harris, and $10k state-party max-outs. Fortune tallied more than $3.4M since 2020 across Powell Jobs and Emerson Collective. Different checkbook from The Atlantic newsroom.
records.source_label: OpenSecrets donor lookup / FEC; Fortune Sep 2024

records.summary: David D. Smith of Cockeysville / Hunt Valley (Sinclair CEO, later executive chairman) has a mixed federal file, not a Super PAC ledger. Same window: $33,000 and $30,000 to the DSCC (Feb 2016, May 2017), $10,000 to the NRCC (Mar 2017), candidate max-outs to Schumer, Wyden, Blunt, Tim Scott, and McCarthy, plus NABPAC. Common name — only the Sinclair employer + Maryland address rows are used. Not Sinclair PAC and not WJLA.
records.source_label: OpenSecrets donor lookup / FEC (Sinclair employer filter)

records.summary: Sinclair Broadcast Group PAC is an employee PAC, not treasury money and not David D. Smith's personal file. FEC shows $33k raised and $26.5k spent in the 2025–26 window through 30 Jun 2026. OpenSecrets lists 18 large 2024-cycle gifts into the PAC from Sinclair officers in Cockeysville, none of them a newsroom budget.
